notes: Margin 0.01 nDCG@10 (absolute, per group): the smallest change treated as meaningful in BEIR/MIRACL-style reporting, about 1-1.5% relative at today's 0.76 (scifact) and 0.99 (de) and about a tenth of the lexical->hybrid gaps measured on 2026-11-02 (+0.10 scifact, +0.20 de). alpha 0.05 two-sided, Holm over the collection's groups. Unjudged threshold 0.10: if more than 1 in 10 top-10 slots of the two arms hold documents unjudged for that query in only one arm, the labels are not trusted for this pair until judged. Pool: every judged passage (relevant and non-relevant) + 2000 filler passages sampled with random.Random(4242) from corpus positions; 2000 keeps a CPU index build in minutes while adding unrelated distractor mass of the same order as the judged pool.
